Game Overview

In Hammer Head, the core idea is straightforward: dive into Hammer Head's frenetic battles, facing a surprise boss each time. Dodge relentless real-time attacks with only five hearts standing between you and defeat. Master strategies, like outsmarting the cactus's chain attack, as you adapt to each encounter's dynamic chaos. Are your reflexes sharp enough to survive?
